mock_response.description: Tender, kid-friendly cutlets made with ground chicken, shredded cabbage, and semolina. Serve with sour cream.
steps: Shred cabbage into thin matchsticks, scald with boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain well; grate onion finely.
Serve with sour cream and any side dish.
mock_response.tip_mistakes: Overmixing the filling makes cutlets tough.
mock_response.tip_serving: Pair with boiled potatoes or mashed carrots.
mock_response.tip_storage: Store in an airtight container for 2 days.
mock_response.tip_why_it_works: Boil and wring the cabbage to remove bitterness and excess water, which prevents soggy cutlets.

Set allergies, foods to avoid, a budget and an eating goal; plan a holiday table for any number of guests or price a menu you picked; and search thousands of recipes with nutrition and cost per portion.
